topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Well, there it is, a right oddity, what the last lot left up yonder. Found it, did you, amidst old rags and forgotten things? It’s not often we stumble upon stories not our own, hiding in the shadows of our attics. I reckon those pots and trinkets have tales as old as the stones in our village, whispering of hands long passed. Best to let them be, those relics. They might hold more meaning than we ken. Maybe a bit of history will seep into your walls, make your home a guardian of secrets. Not a bad thing, keeping the past close, especially when the harvests can be as unpredictable as the saints’ moods.
